text:
riley (product): Capturing notes from the roadmap sync: customers keep asking for clear "island lanes" and a safe spillback strategy. Need a short decision doc with launch gates + price implications by EOW.

cho (eng-plat): Proposal: three-lane model: shared, island (soft isolation with reservation tokens), island-dedicated (hard isolation). Each lane has target SLIs and a cutover playbook.

marta (infra): Implementation options: token reservations on shared pools vs physically carved node islands. Tokens are cheaper but require eviction semantics and spillback rules. Dedicated islands need warm-slot sizing to avoid cold-start latency.

lee (sre): Ops requirements: automated chaos scenarios for island eviction and region blackouts. Abort criteria: user error spike >0.5% or p99 regression >2x baseline. Also need a telemetry event: "spillback.trigger" with fields (tenant, origin_region, dest_region, latency_ms).

julian (sales): Two pilots (BankCo, MedAssist) want island or dedicated lanes. BankCo will pay for dedicated if we guarantee monthly cost cap and fast warm-start. Need a one-pager mapping price multiplier -> expected tail improvement.

cho (eng-plat): Policy sketch (CLI):
```
redwood route create --tenant bankco \
  --lane island-token --preferred eu-west-1,us-east-1 \
  --spillback policy=nearest cost_threshold=2.0
```
Console should show estimated cost, warm-slot recommendation, and a switch to convert token -> dedicated.

research-bot: Note: model-variant compatibility matrix updated; some quantized kernels increase token latency under warm-start. Publishing details to /shared/research/compat/1845678901.

riley (product): Launch gates for MVP island-token:
- policy API + console UI
- billing hooks enforce reservation within 60s
- canary with 2 customers for 48h
- chaos eviction pass in staging
Quality gate: fallback model quality delta < 3% on eval set.

marta (infra): Cost sims pending. I'll include warm-slot sizing per tenant profile and a recommended cold-start buffer SKU.

lee (sre): I'll own the chaos matrix and PagerDuty playbooks. Will coordinate a red-team eviction with canary tenants.

julian (sales): I'll align pilot contracts and propose a migration credit to offset first-month commit.

deploy-bot: canary deploy for route-policy-api started on staging at 1845678975 :rocket:

riley (product): I'll draft the decision doc and call out owners. Add missing risks in comments.
